auth.mobile_help: We'll send a one-time code to verify it's you.
auth.otp_error_invalid: That code isn't right. Please check and try again.
auth.otp_error_expired: That code has expired. Please request a new one.
auth.otp_error_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
auth.mobile_error_invalid: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.
kyc.title: Verify your identity
kyc.choose_method: How would you like to verify your identity?
kyc.consent_explainer: DigiLocker will ask your permission to share your Aadhaar profile with us. We only read your name, date of birth and photo.
kyc.confirm_prompt: Please check these details and confirm they are correct.
kyc.manual_name_required: Please enter your full name as written on your Aadhaar.
kyc.manual_dob_required: Please enter your date of birth.
kyc.fallback_empathy: DigiLocker is unavailable — you can enter your details manually and we'll verify them.
kyc.hard_mandatory_block: Verification through DigiLocker is required to continue. Manual entry is not available right now.
kyc.error_provider_unavailable: DigiLocker isn't responding right now. You can enter your details manually instead.
kyc.error_user_consent_denied: Permission wasn't given in DigiLocker. You can try again or enter your details manually.
kyc.error_verification_failed: We couldn't verify those details. You can try again or enter your details manually.
kyc.error_signature_invalid: We couldn't confirm the DigiLocker response. You can enter your details manually instead.
kyc.error_certificate_stale: Verification is temporarily unavailable. You can enter your details manually instead.
kyc.error_transaction_expired: That took too long and the session expired. Please start the verification again.
kyc.error_transaction_not_found: We couldn't find that verification session. Please start again.
